types.name: AllowedBasketMint
docs: Marker: this mint may be a basket leg. PDA ["basket", mint].

fields.name: amounts
docs: Per epoch leg, in basket order.

types.name: ClaimStatus
docs: Existence = claimed. PDA ["claim", epoch, account].

types.name: Config
docs: Protocol-wide configuration (the old DividendVaultFactory storage). One per program.

fields.name: pending_admin
docs: Two-step admin transfer; `Pubkey::default()` when none is pending.

fields.name: operator
docs: The keeper. Harvests, settles swaps, publishes roots, delivers claims.

fields.name: dispute_window
docs: Seconds after `publish_epoch` during which the creator or admin may cancel it.

fields.name: claim_window
docs: Seconds after `claimable_at` before anyone may expire the epoch.

fields.name: expected_mint
docs: The pump mint the creator will launch with this vault as `creator`.

types.name: Epoch
docs: One payout epoch. PDA ["epoch", vault, id].

fields.name: leg_inputs
docs: Per leg: quote reserved for swapping (or credited directly when the leg is the quote mint).

types.name: Leg
docs: One basket leg with its accounting. Invariant per leg (raw units, checked in tests):
`vault_ata(mint).amount >= unallocated + allocated` (+ every leg's `pending_swap` for the quote mint).

fields.name: unallocated
docs: Harvested, not yet assigned to an epoch.

fields.name: allocated
docs: Assigned to open epochs, not yet claimed.

fields.name: pending_swap
docs: Quote reserved for this leg by `harvest_intake`, consumed by `swap_begin`/`swap_settle`.

fields.name: amounts
docs: Per basket leg, in basket order (zero for a leg that pays nothing this epoch).

fields.name: expected_mint
docs: The mint the creator committed to at `create_vault`; `bind_launch` only accepts this one.

fields.name: launch_mint
docs: `Pubkey::default()` until bound.

fields.name: quote_mint
docs: Creator fees arrive in this mint (wrapped SOL for SOL-quoted coins).

fields.name: auto_claim
docs: Creator opt-in for keeper-paid delivery.

fields.name: swap_in_flight
docs: Transient swap session; only ever set inside one transaction (see swap_begin/swap_settle).
